decision_scope: Proceed with the pre-specified full generation and exploratory grading; not a declaration of established semantic judge accuracy.
technical_validation: Pinned models, BF16 GPU-only execution, finite logits, source identities, prompts, seeds, hashes, exact tokenizer encode/decode and EOS checks passed. All saved judge responses reparsed against exact original source and evidence.
semantic_review: Sixteen pre-judge blinded Codex assessments, targeted concerns, and six additional disagreement spot checks. Both API judges agreed with 14/16 assistance and 16/16 refusal references. These are small assistant comparisons, not independent human accuracy estimates.
limitations: Known subjective substantive-assistance and refusal-force boundaries remain. Both original API labels and manual uncertainty overrides are retained.
Stronger-review selection is enriched for difficult cases; its disagreement rate is not an unbiased error estimate.
Only 192 generated tokens are visible; later refusal is unmeasured.
Twelve fixed settings with repeated draws; no claim of broad safety generalization or causal size effects.
Guarded exclusions are retained in counts; their contents must not be reconstructed.
